tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List all sending domains on the account with their verification and DNS status.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Add a sending domain to the account. Returns the DNS records that must be added at the domain registrar (ownership TXT, SPF, DKIM, return path).

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Get one domain with its status and the exact DNS records to add.

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Check the DNS records of a domain and verify it once the records are in place.

tools.name: delete_domain
tools.description: Remove a domain from the account. Email can no longer be sent from it.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show the plan, emails used and remaining in the current period, and when the period ends.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Daily sending statistics: sent, delivered, bounced, blocked, held and received.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List recent sent and received messages with their delivery status.

tools.name: list_suppressions
tools.description: List addresses on the suppression list (email is not sent to them).

tools.name: add_suppression
tools.description: Stop sending to an email address. Removing an address is only possible in the dashboard.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhooks and the available event types. Paid plans only.

tools.name: add_webhook
tools.description: Add a webhook URL that receives delivery events. Paid plans only.

tools.name: set_webhook_enabled
tools.description: Turn a webhook on or off. Paid plans only.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook. Paid plans only.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a test request to a webhook URL. Paid plans only.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List inbound routes (incoming email forwarding). Paid plans only.

tools.name: add_route
tools.description: Forward incoming email for an address on a verified domain to an email address, an https URL or smtp://host:port. The domain MX record must point to KingSMTP. Paid plans only.

tools.name: delete_route
tools.description: Delete an inbound route. Paid plans only.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send one transactional email from a verified domain on the account. Not for bulk or marketing email.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "send_email" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_usage, list_messages, list_suppressions, list_routes · Private data: add_domain, get_domain, verify_domain, add_route · Public sink: delete_domain, list_suppressions, add_suppression, add_webhook, set_webhook_enabled, delete_webhook, test_webhook, list_routes, add_route, send_email · Destructive: delete_domain, delete_webhook, delete_route.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_usage, list_messages, list_suppressions, list_routes · Private data: add_domain, get_domain, verify_domain, add_route · Public sink: delete_domain, list_suppressions, add_suppression, add_webhook, set_webhook_enabled, delete_webhook, test_webhook, list_routes, add_route, send_email · Destructive: delete_domain, delete_webhook, delete_route

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
